title: Rooftop Rain: turning school roofs into water banks

speaker.name: Maya Okafor
speaker.about: water engineer presenting a school pilot to a city audience

notes: Maintenance is two visits a year, done by the roofing contractor.
interview: School boards and city water planners.

audience.name: Jonas

asks.q: Does it work on sloped tile roofs?

audience.name: Aisha
asks: What is runoff, in simple words?

asks.q: Does this work on sloped tile roofs?

replies.answer: Not yet. It needs a flat roof, under 5 degrees.
